headlines.description: Zinedine Zidane's France belatedly turned on the style as late goals from substitutes Désiré Doué, Ryan Cherki and two from Michael Olise saw them come from behind to beat Belgium 4-1 in the UEFA Nations League.
headlines.shortLinkText: France stun Belgium with four late goals

headlines.description: Pio Esposito's late goal sealed a hard-earned win over Türkiye in Bologna and continued Italy's improvement under returning head coach Roberto Mancini.
headlines.shortLinkText: Italian renaissance continues with runaway win over Türkiye
